subject: Request: one-time service offset & concession for LumaTech — latency incident (May 21-22)
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@lumatech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumaTech Billing <billing@lumatech.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Latency spike May 21-22 — request for service offset

Hi Tessa,

We saw significant latency degradation across our primary inference route during May 21 10:00–18:00 and a smaller recurrence on May 22 02:00–03:30. Our engineers captured end-to-end p95 increases from 120ms to nearly 670ms for a ~2 hour window. This materially impacted a customer-facing experiment and resulted in SLA-eligible exposure.

We've attached our usage summary and trace excerpts; billing team flagged the impacted invoices for review. Can Redwood provide a one-time service offset (either invoice credit or a complimentary capacity window) to make LumaTech whole for customer-facing impact? We prefer invoice credit, but are open to short-term dedicated capacity if that simplifies remediation.

We'd like to resolve this ahead of renewal next quarter. Please advise next steps.

Thanks,
Asha Rao
VP Product, LumaTech
Asha@lumatech.com

Attachments: LumaTech-usage-summary-May2027.pdf, sample-traces.txt
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Latency spike May 21-22 — request for service offset

Folks — forwarding Luma's escalation. Summary: multi-hour p95 latency spike on May 21 that impacted production. They've asked for a one-time service offset (invoice credit preferred, or complimentary short-term dedicated capacity). Renewal is upcoming; this is sensitive.

Request: Need an executive sign-off for a concession. Proposed options in my head: 
- Option A: 20% invoice credit on May invoices (simple, predictable)
- Option B: One month of complimentary dedicated capacity (higher operational cost, might help retention)
- Option C: Hybrid: 10% credit + 2 weeks dedicated capacity (binds them longer term)

I've attached our SLA logs for the time range and Luma's usage summary. Suggest we limit to a one-off concession with a short acceptance window + updated SLO guardrail language. Laura/Markus — can you advise required approvals and any financial/legal constraints? Vivek — do you recommend a path to retain?

Thanks,
Tessa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded attachments: SLA-uptime-log-20270521-20270522.csv, LumaTech-usage-summary-May2027.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latency spike May 21-22 — request for service offset

Tessa — reviewed Luma's usage and our logs. The incident aligns with an autoscaler regression in one AZ; internal RCA indicates 2.1 hours of elevated p95 token latency for their primary model route. Financial note: their May invoice (net) is ~$112k; a 20% credit would be ~$22.4k.

Recommendation for approval path: 
1) Approve concession cap: up to 20% credit OR one month of Dedicated Standard (whichever they value more).
2) Concession to be final once Luma signs an acceptance doc acknowledging one-time remediation and an SLA addendum limiting future claims to verified incidents.
3) Require customer to acknowledge they will not pursue further makegood claims for the same incident window.

If approved, finance prefers the credit be issued as an invoice adjustment tied to deal id DL-2027-0198. We'll also require the legal concession doc (quick amendment) — Markus, can you draft the short form?

—Laura
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latency spike May 21-22 — request for service offset

Laura — happy to. Drafting a one-page concession amendment: 
- State incident window and confirmed Redwood mitigation actions.
- Specify concession: choose A (20% credit on May invoice) OR B (30 days Dedicated Standard starting on acceptance date) OR C (10% credit + 14 days Dedicated Standard).
- Acceptance clause: customer must sign within 14 days; concession is final and releases Redwood from additional claims for that incident.
- Non-admission of liability language and no change to ongoing SLA commitments beyond the recorded concession.

I'll circulate a redlined doc by Monday. No blocking legal issues; we should avoid open-ended credits.

—Markus
General Counsel (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@lumatech.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Latency spike May 21-22 — request for service offset

Hi Asha — thanks for the patience while we reviewed this. Redwood will offer a one-time concession to resolve the impact from the May 21–22 latency incident. Please see options below; pick one and we'll send a short amendment for signature: 

Option 1 (Preferred): 20% invoice credit on your May 2027 invoice (applied as invoice adjustment to DL-2027-0198).
Option 2: 30 days of complimentary Dedicated Standard capacity (start date flexible; usage limited to your account only).
Option 3: Hybrid — 10% invoice credit + 14 days Dedicated Standard.

Terms (summary): one-time concession, acceptance required within 14 days, signed amendment releases Redwood from further claims for this incident, and does not constitute admission of liability.

If you confirm which option you prefer, we'll expedite the amendment and process the credit / provisioning within 5 business days of signed acceptance. Appreciate your partnership — want to keep you in a good spot ahead of renewal.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-concession-terms-LumaTech.docx
